from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "BSA Standard Curve", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 3)
    tuberack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 1)
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 4)
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])
    # Define liquids
    bsa = protocol.define_liquid(name="bsa", description="BSA stock", display_color="#FF0000")
    water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="Water", display_color="#0000FF")
    # Load liquids into source wells
    bsa_tube = tuberack["A1"]
    bsa_tube.load_liquid(liquid=bsa, volume=200)  # load 200 ul of bsa
    water_well = reservoir["A1"]
    water_well.load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=1000)  # load 1000 ul of water
    # Pick up tip
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    # Define wells for standards
    wells = ["A1","A2","A3","A4","A5","A6","A7","A8"]
    prev_well_name = None
    for i, well_name in enumerate(wells):
        well = plate[well_name]
        # Determine diluent volume
        if i == 0:
            diluent_vol = 0
        else:
            diluent_vol = 50
        # Determine transfer volume and source
        if i == 0:
            transfer_vol = 100
            source = tuberack["A1"]
        else:
            transfer_vol = 50
            source = plate[prev_well_name]
        # Add diluent (water) if needed
        if diluent_vol > 0:
            p300.aspirate(diluent_vol, water_well)
            p300.dispense(diluent_vol, well)
        # Transfer in from source
        p300.aspirate(transfer_vol, source)
        p300.dispense(transfer_vol, well)
        # Mix: aspirate total volume and dispense back a couple of times
        total_vol = diluent_vol + transfer_vol  # should be 100 for all
        p300.aspirate(total_vol, well)
        for _ in range(2):
            p300.dispense(total_vol, well)
        # Update previous well name
        prev_well_name = well_name
    # Remove 50 ul from the last well to waste
    waste_well = reservoir["A2"]
    p300.aspirate(50, plate["A8"])
    p300.dispense(50, waste_well)
    # Drop tip
    p300.drop_tip()
```

tool_calls.arguments:
{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {'protocolName': 'BSA Standard Curve', 'apiLevel': '2.19'}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    plate = protocol.load_labware('nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt', 3)
    tuberack = protocol.load_labware('opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap', 2)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware('nest_12_reservoir_15ml', 1)
    tips = protocol.load_labware('opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul', 4)
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument('p300_single_gen2', 'right', tip_racks=[tips])
    # Define liquids
    bsa = protocol.define_liquid(name='bsa', description='BSA stock', display_color='#FF0000')
    water = protocol.define_liquid(name='water', description='Water', display_color='#0000FF')
    # Load liquids
    bsa_tube = tuberack['A1']
    bsa_tube.load_liquid(liquid=bsa, volume=100)  # 100 ul of stock BSA
    water_reservoir = reservoir['A1']
    water_reservoir.load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=400)  # enough water for diluent additions
    waste_well = reservoir['A2']  # waste destination
    # Define the 8 wells for the standards
    wells = ['A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'A5', 'A6', 'A7', 'A8']
    prev_source = None
    for i, well_name in enumerate(wells):
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        well = plate[well_name]
        # Determine diluent and transfer volumes
        if i == 0:
            diluent_vol = 0
            transfer_vol = 100
            source = bsa_tube
        else:
            diluent_vol = 50
            transfer_vol = 50
            source = plate[prev_source]
        # Add diluent (water) if required
        if diluent_vol > 0:
            p300.aspirate(diluent_vol, water_reservoir)
            p300.dispense(diluent_vol, well)
            p300.mix(5, 40, well)  # mix the added water
        # Transfer the sample
        p300.aspirate(transfer_vol, source)
        p300.dispense(transfer_vol, well)
        # Mix the combined volume
        total_vol = diluent_vol + transfer_vol
        p300.mix(5, 40, well)
        # Drop tip and move to next well
        p300.drop_tip()
        prev_source = well_name
    # Remove 50 ul from the last well to waste
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(50, plate['A8'])
    p300.dispense(50, waste_well)
    p300.drop_tip()"}

   Well Reservoir 15 mL reaches only 0.75 mm up: the tip is above the liquid and draws air
   (this line did it twice, after 5 times in the liquid; 100 ul of air in all). The

   draws got air instead of liquid.

   reach 1 mm. Load that much more than the run draws; or draw from a smaller vessel (a tube

   well A8 in slot 3 from an earlier step. A tip that has touched one liquid leaves a little
   of it in the next liquid it touches, so this stock now holds material that does not
   belong there. The protocol does not draw from it again, so this run is not harmed, but
